items.text: Will a Lean redesign of the TB contact pathway, introduced from January 2027, raise the proportion of contacts completing evaluation within 60 days from 71 to at least 85 percent by December 2027, with no fall for shelter, shift-working or interpreter-needing contacts?
items.population: Contacts of pulmonary tuberculosis cases notified by the city public health unit
items.intervention: Value stream mapping and redesign: home blood draw, direct result routing, same-visit X-ray booking
items.outcome: Completion of evaluation within 60 days, charted by index-case month
items.setting: City public health unit TB program

finer: Feasible within existing staff and the approved extract; interesting to the program and the province; novel locally; ethical with equity reporting; relevant to a completion rate far below target.
summary: One improvement aim with an equity condition.
